Elena Park: Heads-up — noticing a sustained drop in feature X API calls for Solstice Health over the last 14 days. ~42% vs previous 14d. New PM replaced Emily and mentioned evaluating a competitor PoC next week. Anyone else tracking this? Need a playbook.

metrics-bot: [Automated alert] Account: Solstice Health (acct_3487) — Metric: request_rate. 14d avg = 180 req/day (−42% vs prev 14d). Active seats: 38 (−6). Top routes down: /summarize (−60%), /embed (−47%). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/3487/health

Noah Kim: Thanks Elena. Can you DM the latest contract end date? Also flag AE to re-engage. :eyes:

Elena Park: Contract end = 2025-11-30. Sharing last call notes in DM now.

Samir Patel: I'll reach out to procurement/buyer. Do we have a reason logged for the switch — price vs feature gap?

Priya Rao: From demo notes: they wanted better latency on long docs and native retriever support. We can propose Dedicated with quantization + batching configs — that should improve latency and cost. I can draft a technical comparison (latency + embedding quality) by EOD tomorrow.

Elena Park: They also mentioned a short competitor trial next week. Can we offer a 2-week extended pilot on Dedicated with a simple SLO and 1:1 onboarding to keep them engaged?

Samir Patel: That seems sensible. I'll propose exec webinar + extended pilot as a non-monetary concession. Will need RevOps/legal signoff for SOW addendum.

Noah Kim: Approve pilot extension if CSM commits to weekly health checks and we get the SOW addendum. @Samir loop in RevOps & Legal.

Priya Rao: I'll prepare a 1-pager with perf deltas (current vs Dedicated+quant) and the minimal config steps. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Elena Park: Action plan: 1) Samir to coordinate procurement + exec intro 2) Priya to deliver technical brief 3) Weekly checkpoints (Elena) 4) Offer 2-week pilot extension with SLO. I'll schedule stakeholder sync for Tue 10am PT. @Samir @Priya pls confirm.

Samir Patel: Confirmed. I'll kick off the procurement thread.

Priya Rao: Confirmed. I'll attach perf graphs to the brief and be on the sync.

Elena Park: Thanks team :pray:
